title: Transport along Local Annealing Paths: Wasserstein Geometry and Multimodal Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2611.05605v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Variational approaches to learning transport maps for multimodal sampling can suffer from mode collapse. One way to mitigate this problem is to learn transport along a prescribed path of intermediate distributions defined by geometric annealing. We show that annealing can take a substantial detour in Wasserstein space: when mass moves between modes, the path can be much longer than the distance between its endpoints. We further link path geometry to transport learning, showing that long annealing paths can slow population optimization, while sufficiently regular paths permit rapid convergence. Motivated by these findings, we propose componentwise annealed transport (CAT) to reduce the need for mass transfer between modes. Starting from a mode-informed mixture reference, CAT constructs an exact mixture decomposition of the target and learns separate transport maps along componentwise annealing paths. translated_title: 沿局部退火路径的传输：Wasserstein几何与多模态采样
translated_abstract: 用于多模态采样的变分传输映射学习方法可能会出现模式坍塌。缓解这一问题的一种途径是在由几何退火定义的、由中间分布构成的给定路径上学习传输。我们证明退火在Wasserstein空间中可能会绕出相当大的弯路：当概率质量在各个模式之间移动时，路径长度可能远大于其端点之间的距离。我们进一步将路径几何与传输学习联系起来，表明较长的退火路径会拖慢种群优化，而足够正则的路径则允许快速收敛。受这些发现的启发，我们提出了分量退火传输（CAT），以减少模式间质量传输的需求。CAT 从一个融入模式信息的混合参考分布出发，构造目标的精确混合分解，并沿各分量的退火路径分别学习独立的传输映射。我们估计分量权重，从而……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了几何退火路径在Wasserstein空间中可能远长于端点距离从而拖慢传输映射学习，并提出分量退火传输（CAT），通过将目标精确分解为混合分量并沿各分量退火路径学习独立传输映射来减少模式间质量传输，缓解多模态采样中的模式坍塌。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that geometric annealing paths can take substantial detours in Wasserstein space, being much longer than the distance between their endpoints and slowing transport learning, and proposes componentwise annealed transport (CAT), which constructs an exact mixture decomposition of the target and learns separate transport maps along componentwise annealing paths to reduce inter-mode mass transfer and mitigate mode collapse in multimodal sampling.
